purpose: Causal exchange of equal-valued existing Phase-B Vec storage between retained same-plan Estimate/Measure objects
phases: ABBA or BAAB from process bit1; A original storage, B exchanged; construction bit0 and member start bit2 independent
invariants: same FFT shape, direction, all metadata and bitwise coefficient values
existing Vec pointer ownership only; no coefficient allocation or copy
unique strong/weak ownership checked before every swap
original owners restored and independently audited
decision: A repeatable reversal or reduction of the instance gap after table exchange identifies a contribution from that storage location; absent/inconsistent reversal is negative or inconclusive and does not justify alignment changes. Must inspect both repeated assignments and all processes/placements/directions.
fixed_rule: one fixed four-cell/eight-process diagnostic, preserve all failures; no retry-until-pass
gate: fresh60s sustained quiet plus envcheck, core4/SMT12 reservation, continuous monitoring; no concurrent builds/tests
limitations: tuning vtable/code layout differs from production
original timing and secondary planning precede replay
sham swaps perform two equality scans vs one for changed assignment, followed by equal200ms warmup
not acceptance and cannot waive prior failures
